purpose: Interactive, specification-driven TeslaSync API explorer with live request composition, response inspection and browser-session request history.
primaryGoal: Find an endpoint, inspect its documentation, supply parameters/body/optional API key, deliberately send it and inspect the actual HTTP response without mistaking local history for server-wide traffic.

dataSources.name: OpenAPI specification

evidence.detail: request('/system/openapi') requests YAML text with same-origin credentials, then js-yaml and parseSpec derive endpoints.

dataSources.behavior: Explicit reload and initial retry; retained endpoint data survives refresh failure through deriveDataState. Counts are specification-derived, not measured traffic. No backend response was fetched during this audit.

dataSources.name: Operator-triggered raw HTTP inspection
dataSources.endpoint: Selected OpenAPI path with GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE; apiUrl supplies the configured API/demo base and /api/v1 prefix

evidence.detail: Same-origin credentials, existing authHeaders, raw fetch, elapsed time to response headers, full response text, Blob byte size, JSON parse with malformed-text retention and exposed response headers.
apiUrl owns normal/demo API base selection and path normalization.
Existing authHeaders composition is reused; no credential value was inspected or changed.

dataSources.behavior: Non-2xx responses remain inspectable rather than throwing solely for HTTP status. Optional X-API-Key stays component-local and is not saved in history or passed into snippet generation. Runtime permissions, actual spec paths and endpoint effects are unknown; no live requests were sent.

dataSources.name: Session-local request metadata

evidence.detail: sessionStorage key teslasync-api-playground-history; MAX_HISTORY 20; read/write failures are tolerated.
Resolved HTTP requests save method, query-stripped concrete path, status, duration and ISO timestamp; no body, response payload or API key.
Replay prefers exact same-method path, then nonempty template-segment match; it only selects an endpoint, never sends.

dataSources.behavior: Recent count and average latency are independent of spec availability. Network exceptions are not appended. Replay does not restore prior path values, query or body.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Existing page-width adapter delegates header/actions/freshness/error boundary to PageContainer, retaining min-w-0 and container context.

components.name: PageContainer source trust
components.contract: PageErrorBoundary and DataSourceNotice wrap children; query feeds header freshness. Page passes spec query/dataSources, not global loading/error, so independent summaries remain.

components.name: AdminSummary -> OperationalBrief
components.contract: Existing domain adapter uses useOperationalMetrics and compact OperationalBrief; translated source status, scope, provenance and optional freshness. Two independently scoped briefs on this page.

components.name: Card, GlassPanel, LayoutCard, Text
components.contract: Category-barrel primitives/layout composition rather than a new page surface engine.

components.name: Button
components.contract: Existing variants, focus, disabled, loading/aria-busy and wrapLabel; local overrides bypass parts of sizing/theming.

components.name: Textarea
components.contract: Existing generated identity and label/feedback composition; caller must supply label or accessible name.

components.name: EndpointSidebar / MethodBadge
components.contract: Page-specific method identity, endpoint search, counts, grouping/disclosure and selection.

components.name: RequestBuilder
components.contract: Network-free request tuple composition; parameter defaults, live URL preview, examples, optional auth and non-GET confirmation.

components.name: ResponseViewer / SnippetPanel
components.contract: Actual response state, status/timing/size/body/headers, local replay chips; four-format snippets and CopyButton.

components.name: Skeleton / EmptyState / QueryError / FadeIn
components.contract: Existing feedback/motion categories; no replacement global async or animation system needed.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Local formatBytes duplicates web\src\lib\numberFormat.ts:163, including binary KB/MB presentation but different missing/invalid behavior and no GB branch.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse the existing formatter with explicit compatible options; preserve real zero and distinguish invalid/missing input. Keep existing precision/locale and raw response metadata.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: History chips duplicate EndpointSidebar.tsx:44-62 method colors but collapse PUT/PATCH into amber, unlike the shared local MethodBadge.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse/extend the existing page-domain MethodBadge with a compact presentation, retaining textual method and all five identities. Do not add a global status registry.

strategy.detail: Single column below xl; xl uses 20rem explorer plus minmax workspace. Explorer is 26rem tall below xl and sticky viewport-height at xl.
Request/response stack until 2xl, then two columns; min-w-0 is preserved on workspace sections.
History uses deliberate horizontal scrolling; response and snippets use local overflow, with response max height 500px.

issues.detail: Nonwrapping confirmation row combines icon, explanation and two controls. Parameter/auth rows use fixed w-28 labels plus inputs (lines 140, 163, 204). Long translations/names at 320px can squeeze controls; actual overflow is unverified.
issues.fix: Reflow confirmation and label/input pairs at narrow allocated widths; allow long labels and preserve both confirmation actions, preview, all parameters and authentication help.

issues.rule: MDC-043: retain all snippet controls on mobile
issues.detail: Four format buttons plus Copy share one nonwrapping toolbar; 320px, text zoom and long translations were not exercised.
issues.fix: Use wrapping/stacking within the current panel while keeping all four formats and copy reachable; test local scroll owners and 200% text.

accessibility.verification: runtime, keyboard, focus, screen-reader, effective contrast, forced colors and reduced-motion behavior unverified
existing: Localized labelled overview/explorer/workspace/request/response sections and reload accessible name (ApiPlaygroundPage.tsx:110-180).
Search accessible name, disclosure aria-expanded and decorative icon hiding (EndpointSidebar.tsx:96,179).
Explicit path/query/API-key label associations (RequestBuilder.tsx:141,164,205); password input and auth helper.
Confirmation role=alert; response body labelled region; headers/snippets aria-expanded; format aria-pressed; shared CopyButton (RequestBuilder.tsx:106; ResponseViewer.tsx:162,177,225,334).
Existing Button focus styling and PageContainer route-focus heading remain in composition.

issues.detail: Request-body UiTextarea has no label, aria-label or aria-labelledby. Preceding h4 is not associated with its generated ID; Textarea primitive does not derive a name from nearby headings.
issues.fix: Pass the localized request-body label through the existing Textarea API or associate an explicit stable ID with the visible heading; retain body content/example and content-type context.

issues.detail: Selected endpoint is communicated by background/border classes only; endpoint button has no aria-pressed/current state. Long paths are truncated and title contains summary, not full path.
issues.fix: Expose explicit selected state and make the full path available on focus/touch without removing method or summary.

issues.detail: Snippet/header/history and explorer controls override height with !h-auto and very small vertical padding (ResponseViewer.tsx:163,179,226,264; EndpointSidebar.tsx:123). Actual target bounds/spacing exceptions are not measured.
issues.fix: Use existing Button sizing or responsive minimum target sizes with verified spacing; preserve compact desktop density and all controls.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-040: announce actual async work
issues.detail: Spec loading disables reload, but PageContainer receives neither loading nor busy; request Send receives disabled rather than Button.loading (RequestBuilder.tsx:93), and custom request/response region has no explicit busy/result announcement.
issues.fix: Wire nonblocking busy/status semantics through existing APIs without replacing independent local history or retained endpoint content; announce completion/failure once.

states.specification: Initial: 12 skeleton rows plus unknown specification metrics; fatal error: QueryError with retry; successful empty: no-endpoints EmptyState with reload; populated: searchable explorer; retained refresh error/offline: deriveDataState retains data, summary marks stale and PageContainer receives query/dataSources for existing notices. Empty array is not passed as unavailable to deriveDataState, so zero-count loaded snapshot and empty explorer coexist.
states.workspace: No selected endpoint: explicit selection prompt with available endpoint count. Selection clears response; no automatic selection or execution.
states.request: GET sends directly; every non-GET first shows inline alert confirmation and can be canceled; Send disabled while loading. Parameter defaults and body reset on endpoint changes; API-key state does not reset on selection changes.
states.response: Pending skeleton replaces previous response presentation without deleting its state. No response shows send prompt. HTTP status/body including errors remain viewable. Network exception synthesizes status 0, Network error text and error body, duration/size 0; no corresponding history record.
states.history: Metadata limited to latest 20 resolved requests; history strip absent if empty and only mounted once an endpoint is selected; local summary visible independently. Replay selects matching endpoint without sending or restoring previous request parameters.
states.snippets: Only mounted after response exists, initially collapsed; cURL, JavaScript, Python, Go and copy. No actual API key included.

issues.rule: MDC-025 / MDC-026: failure must not look successful
issues.detail: statusColor/statusBg treat all status values below 300 as green, including synthesized network-error status 0 from ApiPlaygroundPage.tsx:68-72.
issues.fix: Handle status 0/non-HTTP failures as explicit network-error presentation before HTTP ranges; retain error body/text and distinguish unavailable duration/size from measured zero.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-012 / MDC-020: semantic neutral chrome
visualIssues.detail: Fixed-white hover/selection/border backgrounds override token-aware ghost Button; cyan selection border and fixed green/blue/amber/red/purple method ramp form a separate local palette. ResponseViewer repeats white chrome at lines 169,170,232,264,335. No neon/glow classes or static inline styles found in inspected page/control files.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing surface/control/border and semantic tokens with restrained selected-state cues; preserve method and HTTP-status meaning and verify actual contrast in themes/forced colors.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-013 / MDC-014: typography and density contracts
visualIssues.detail: Raw labels/code/pre and numerous !text-xs/2xs, !py and tracking-wider overrides create an extra compact scale. Shared Text is already used widely; no new typography engine is justified.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing Label/Code/Text role APIs and density-aware controls where compatible, retaining monospace technical identity and readable full metadata.

architectureIssues.detail: Inline spec queryFn ignores TanStack Query signal although request accepts it. Manual request transport is intentionally separate to retain raw error/non-JSON responses; blindly replacing it with request would change inspector behavior.
architectureIssues.fix: Forward queryFn signal into the existing specification request, optionally moving the same key/policy/parser to a typed domain hook without changing cache/retry semantics. Preserve deliberate live-request transport and raw responses.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-046: persisted data must remain usable
architectureIssues.detail: JSON.parse result is cast to HistoryEntry[] without shape validation. Valid JSON such as an object/null or malformed entries can break history.length/reduce/render assumptions. Storage parse/write exceptions are already tolerated.
architectureIssues.fix: Validate array and entry metadata at this existing persistence boundary while keeping the storage key, 20-entry order/cap and credential exclusion unchanged.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-045 / preservation: generated snippets must reflect request behavior
architectureIssues.detail: Snippet generators interpolate URL/body into source strings without language-specific escaping; Python inserts JSON literals directly, JavaScript assumes JSON response. Transport always sets application/json for non-GET body (playgroundRequest.ts:14), even when parsed request-body contentType advertises another media type. Specific affected production endpoints are unknown.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve all four snippets and raw inspector; make generation language-safe and clearly describe supported body/response formats. Verify actual spec media types before any transport behavior change; do not invent upload/form controls.

priority.reason: The working explorer/inspector is already composed with current shared layout and summaries. Focus modernization on network-error truth, accessible body/selection state and narrow-width controls before cosmetic changes; preserve deliberate write confirmation and raw-response behavior.
order: Network-error semantics and accessible body field
Endpoint selection/busy semantics and mobile reachability
Persisted-history validation and snippet correctness with focused tests

competingImplementations.detail: Local byte formatter competes with existing web\src\lib\numberFormat.ts:163; reuse existing owner, no new shared component.
History method styling competes with existing local MethodBadge, not evidence for a new application-wide registry.
Uses existing PageLayout and AdminSummary/OperationalBrief; no alternative theme, page layout, query-state store or workspace selector found in assigned page dependencies.

preservation.sourceHashScope: Exact bytes of web\src\features\admin\pages\ApiPlaygroundPage.tsx; not a dependency-tree hash
preservation.sectionCountingMethod: Eight named capabilities, including conditionally mounted snippets/history and selection-dependent workspace; not eight simultaneously visible panels.
actions: Replay history by endpoint selection only
dataBehavior: Keep /api-playground route and lazy SafeRoute mount (web\src\App.tsx:266,728).

Keep spec YAML parsing, local references, operation tag/summary/description/defaults/examples, method ordering and exact endpoint paths; parser supports five methods and takes first tag (playgroundSpec.ts:59-90). Responses metadata is parsed but not currently displayed.
Keep query key ['openapi-spec'], infinite staleTime, inherited retries, manual refresh and retained-data failure behavior.

Keep unknown spec metrics distinct from zero; local history metrics remain independent. Latency raw milliseconds are divided by 1000 for StatMetric latency display only (ApiPlaygroundPage.tsx:103-104).
Keep current query encoding and literal dollar-token path substitution; do not silently execute an endpoint on selection or replay.
Keep every non-GET confirmation, explicit API-key choice, browser session/default auth composition and demo/base routing boundaries.

Keep response status/text/body/raw bodyText/content type/exposed headers, malformed JSON fallback, response byte size and elapsed-to-headers measurement; do not relabel this as full body-download latency.
Keep sessionStorage history key/cap/order/metadata-only privacy, exact-before-template matching and no-request replay. Do not change replay to auto-send.
Keep all four snippet formats and copy, full response/body/header details and local scroll access on mobile.
Keep existing localized labels, summary source/scope statements, stable explicit request-field IDs and current raw payloads/preferences.
